instruction: Candid documentary photograph from a high-angle overhead view of an office meeting room. The team celebrates with raised hands. On the left, the man with wavy grey hair (R1) in a brown suit smiles with his hands up. At the top-center, the bald Black man (R3) in a white shirt and black tie cheers with both arms raised. On the top-right, the older Black man (R4) in a dark suit and red tie laughs with his hands raised. On the right, the woman with curly black hair (R2) in a black top raises her arm. In the foreground, a bystander with short white hair in a grey jacket sits with her back to the camera, raising her hands in celebration. Warm, bright indoor lighting fills the room.
elements: R1 smiles with his hands up during the celebration
R2 raises her arm during the celebration
R3 cheers with both arms raised
R4 laughs with his hands raised
a bystander in the foreground raises her hands in celebration
